uxo-ukraine.n: Ukraine: landmine, UXO and IED contamination since the 2022 full-scale invasion
fig: Ministry of Economy National Mine Action Platform: 132,076 km2 'territories affected by hostilities / under risk'; 41,924 km2 returned to users (demine.gov.ua). MoD (Jun 2025): 139,000 km2 potentially contaminated incl. 14,000 km2 of water bodies; humanitarian demining possible on only 31,000 km2. Ministry of Economy via Rada committee (Mar 2025): 174,000 km2 (>27% of the country), 35,000 km2 returned in 2024. State Dept (Sep 2023 figure): 174,000 km2 incl. 25,000 km2 farmland. (as of platform panel read 2026-11-25; MoD 2025-06-13)

uxo-germany-brandenburg.n: Germany: WWII bombs and munitions, Brandenburg incl. Oranienburg
fig: WWII aircraft bombs (many with chemical long-delay fuzes), munitions

Brandenburg KMBD 2025: ~360 t of munitions found; 897 ha released from suspicion by end November (MIK, 22 Dec 2025). Oranienburg: 233 high-explosive bombs found Oct 1991-Nov 2024, ~55% with dangerous fuzes (many chemical long-delay), 109 defused, 34 blown up in place (state government). MIK: no region in Germany is known where WWII consequences lie so heavily in the ground. (as of 2025)

uxo-ss-richard-montgomery.n: SS Richard Montgomery wreck with ~1,400 t of explosives, Thames Estuary
fig: WWII munitions cargo in a wreck

US Liberty ship that grounded on Sheerness Middle Sand on 20 Aug 1944 carrying 6,127 imperial tons of cargo, mainly munitions; 2,954 t were salvaged; approximately 1,400 t NEQ remain in forward holds 1-3; 1.5 miles from Sheerness, 5 miles from Southend; designated a dangerous wreck under s.2 Protection of Wrecks Act 1973 with a no-entry exclusion zone (MCA). 2024 survey: forward section still tilting east (43-55 cm shift at the foremast 2022-24). (as of 2024-2025 surveys)
Monitored by annual MCA surveys; not cleared.

uxo-okinawa.n: Okinawa: Battle of Okinawa unexploded ordnance
fig: About 200,000 t of ammunition was used in Okinawa; an estimated 5% (10,000 t) remained as UXO; ~3,000 t were cleared by residents and ~2,500 t by US forces before 1972, and ~2,122 t by the SDF to FY2022; allowing 500 t never to be found, ~1,878 t remained buried (FY2022 yearbook). FY1972-FY2024 total: 40,825 disposals, 2,156.2 t (FY2024 yearbook). A March 1974 UXO explosion during sewer work in Oroku, Naha, killed or injured 30-odd people. (as of FY2022 / FY2024 yearbooks)
